blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY — A second sea travel company has prohibited its vessels from ferrying electric vehicles amidst ongoing investigations into an alleged explosion that ignited the September 9 fire that engulfed a Coron-bound ship and killed 77 of its passengers. Island Water has imposed an immediate ban on hybrid and fully electric vehicles (EVs) on all its passenger ships, citing safety concerns over high-capacity vehicle batteries and alternative powertrain technologies.
